cards.title: Project-Specific Translation Profile Requirements
cards.claim: The project-specific translation profile (MP005) requires qualified animal estimates with provenance, compatible units, and justified species comparability. It mandates preflight checks to ensure unique qualified species counts and prohibits pooling incompatible parameters (e.g., CL/F with absolute CL). Unmet prerequisites block specific predictions.
conditions: Applies when using the project's defined empirical interspecies parameter extrapolation method.
Requires explicit method specification and project permission.
required_inputs: Qualified animal estimates for the exact parameter.
Body weights and units compatible with the scaling equation.
Explicit method specification and justification of comparability.
limitations: This is a project-local draft requirement, not an external scientific law.
Does not establish a universal minimum species count; this is assessed per parameter.
cards.downstream_use: Use to gate the initiation of translation analysis and ensure data integrity before scaling calculations are performed.
cards.retrieval_keywords: Animal parameter uncertainty, scaling-method discrepancy and prospective human uncertainty

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
